selection: All drugs passing frozen expansion-feasibility-1.0; no rank/score selection
independence: Donors are independent units; cultures and controls are nested and reused across drugs; drug results not independent
normalization: Per drug matched samples, retained genes TMM/logCPM prior.count=0.5, same as cardiac-1.0
primary_endpoint: Same as cardiac-1.0: frozen disease DOWN set drug-minus-control mean percentile-rank change minus UP set change; equal cultures within donor then equal donors
primary_test: Each drug: exhaustive donor sign flips, one-sided positive mean. BH across all 21 eligible drugs including known VEM; additional BH excluding VEM explicitly sensitivity
small_sample_limit: 4 donor drugs have minimum one-sided exact P=0.0625, 5 donor drugs 0.03125, 6 donor drugs 0.015625; no substitution of parametric P to get significance
harmonized_comparison: Common measured-landmark background passing pre-effect gene filter for every eligible drug; both LINCS z and cardiac donor logFC scored by original weighted ES with opposing-sign gate; same frozen mapped UP/DOWN queries
harmonized_aggregation: LINCS median within cell then median cells; cardiac median of donor ES. Median duplicate chemically equivalent perturbation-ID scores if needed
comparison_statistics: Descriptive Spearman, same-sign and nonzero coverage; leave-one-donor and leave-one-drug-out ranges. No independent-drug P or bootstrap CI because shared donors/controls and drug-class correlation
auxiliary_gene_analysis: paired-donor limma-trend as earlier, per-drug gene BH only, not a global cross-drug gene-discovery family
mechanism_scope: No new pathway selection; no confirmatory gene/mechanism claims from secondary drug ranking
outlier_rule: No effect-based exclusions; verify libraries positive and metadata gates
scope_limit: Different dose and time from LINCS; common metric does not isolate cell type causally; no disease rescue or functional safety validation
prior_knowledge: VEM effect and original LINCS rankings known before this expansion; all other cardiac drug effects not viewed
